runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
OMB M-25-22 applies to new AI contracts 180 days after the memorandum is issued. The memo covers any contract awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance of this memorandum. It also reaches any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract after that same 180-day date.

The memo does not cover AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System.
